note: A bursty relay from the generator (chapter 15.4 B-100): per second of send time a delivery level drawn in 0..200 ms from the seed (the 1 s minima scatter with an IQR of about 100 ms, as TECH01's), on TECH01's burst shape as B-95's syn-step fixtures carry it (usual 300 ms, +200 then +400 for 12 s, a dip to 100 for 11 s) every 150 s; the source clock fast by 50 ppm. The first bucket's level holds under half of the buckets, so the first fit waits for the full 300 s window and is made on its densest band: locked at 306-308 s; the band reads the floor over the window, not the clock (about zero whatever the clock, B-100's known limit), so the rate is pinned to the alarm bound only.
